fields.summary_ko.0: Micron Technology (MU) rose 123% in 2026 but declined 32% since July; ahead of Q1 earnings announcement in December, DRAM revenue is projected to increase approximately 4.5x year-over-year as the memory supercycle continues.
fields.summary_ko.1: Q3 2026 DRAM market size reached $200 billion, with memory prices continuing to rise; TrendForce predicts memory prices will increase 70–140% in 2027.
